Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
Renewal window: one page gives the mailed reminder at about six months and the renewal window as 180 days before expiration; the dossier states both as printed without converting one into the other [A04].
The page on the new card says licenses may be renewed up to six months before the customer's birthday, phrased differently from the renewal section; both are kept as printed on their own pages [A03] (verify NC-INS-D-RENEW).
Fees and phone numbers are service details that can change and are isolated as dynamic.
Veteran discharge-document code lists and military examples with past calendar years were summarized, not copied.
